Sculpt Lead acoustic factory bank

Source library: VS Chamber Orchestra: Community Edition (VSCO 2 CE)
Source repository: https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE
Official website: https://versilian-studios.com/vsco-community/
Pinned WAV commit: 440300901dfe9275fd84e0b7763af1f8443ae62e
SFZ mapping release: 1.1.0

Recordings by Sam Gossner / Versilian Studios and Simon Dalzell / Ivy Audio.
Original sample cutting by Elan Hickler / Soundemote.

The original recordings are available under CC0 1.0 Universal.
The complete original license is included as LICENSE in this directory.
Original upstream README.md, Readme.txt and eight SFZ maps are preserved.

Sculpt Lead adaptation:
- Clarinet and non-vibrato flute for Reed.
- Tenor trombone and open trumpet for Brass.
- Stereo-to-mono conversion, resampling, static tuning correction, acoustic
  attack/sustain splicing, crossfade-compatible sustain loops, level matching
  with separate dynamic levels, and deterministic PCM16 dither.
- 202 prepared WAVs representing 103 recorded sustain pitch/dynamic sets.
- Two recorded staccato attack variants share a sustain body where available;
  the low flute notes MIDI 60 and 64 retain one original sustain attack.
- No claim of two independent long-note takes or sampled interval legato.

The exact sources, hashes and derivations are in tools/factory_sources.json
and Samples/manifest.json. Documentation: docs/SAMPLES.md.

This adaptation does not imply endorsement by the original library authors.
